# Tings AI 2.0 â€” Intelligent Market Copilot

> Tings AI 2.0 is an AI-powered financial intelligence platform designed for retail investors in Indonesia. It provides macro-economic context, portfolio concentration risk analysis, and objective market insights without selling speculative buy/sell trading signals.

## Core Features
- **Trifecta AI Orchestrator**: Seamless routing between Google Gemini 3 Pro (macro context), Groq LLaMA-3 (sub-200ms interactive execution), and Local Ollama (zero-downtime privacy fallback).
- **Pusat Komando Pagi (Morning Command Briefing)**: 3-minute daily market pulse covering IHSG, Crypto, US Bond Yields, and macro shifts before the market opens.
- **Portfolio Concentration & Risk Health Check**: Automatic detection of over-concentrated positions to prevent catastrophic drawdowns.
- **Investment Decision Journal**: AI-evaluated journal to track trading psychology and eliminate emotional FOMO trading.
- **Fundamental Ratio Stock Screener**: Clean, un-cluttered fundamental screening for Indonesian stocks.

## Architecture & Technology Stack
- Next.js 16 (Marketing Landing Page at tingsai.my.id)
- React SPA (App Dashboard at app.tingsai.my.id)
- Express / Node.js Backend API
- Trifecta AI Engine: Gemini API + Groq Cloud + Ollama LLaMA-3 Local Server
